query:
SELECT DISTINCT v.product_id AS "product_id!"
           FROM carts c
           JOIN cart_lines l ON l.cart_id = c.id
           JOIN variants v ON v.id = l.variant_id
           WHERE c.shop_token_hash = $1 AND c.status = 'open' AND c.market_id = $2
             AND c.last_activity_at > $3
